records.trigger: Baseline host proof is version-only and launcher templates are not readiness-safe.
records.observedFailure: Baseline read-only assertion fails with missing executionReady/reviewReady/progressMode/failureKind/reviewReadyHostCount, agyUsesPromptFile=true, and claudeLacksObservableStream=true.
records.note: Red evidence maps directly to user request: wrong/silent launcher and version-only host proof must stop before degraded fallback.

records.trigger: version-only host availability proof cannot establish noninteractive reviewer launcher readiness
records.observedFailure: Baseline review_host_availability_probe help/contract describes probing canonical hosts by executable path plus --version only and does not expose executionReady, reviewReadyHostCount, progressMode, or failureKind, so a version-only available host could be mistaken for a review-ready host before degraded fallback.
records.note: Red evidence is based on the pre-fix command surface: version-only availability has no launcher-readiness fields. Green evidence must prove the strengthened probe/gate behavior without recording secrets or raw provider transcripts.
